subject: [PATCH v3 02/12] nfsd: take freeze protection before updating delegation timestamps

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch addresses a bug in the NFS server where it can modify a frozen filesystem by updating delegation timestamps without holding freeze protection. The patch takes freeze protection before updating delegation timestamps in three functions: cb_getattr_update_times(), nfsd_update_cmtime_attr(), and nfsd4_finalize_deleg_timestamps(). It also introduces pinning of fi_deleg_file to prevent racing DELEGRETURN or revocation from putting the file open. This ensures that the filesystem remains frozen even when updating delegation timestamps, preventing potential data corruption.
